hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgh\s+pr\s+merge\b'; then if [ "${ALLOW_AUTO_MERGE:-}" != "1" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: gh pr merge requires explicit user approval per AGENTS.md. Ask the user first, then have them rerun the command with ALLOW_AUTO_MERGE=1 prefixed.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0
